description: This file defines the main application structure and delegate for a macOS app using SwiftUI, AppKit, and other Apple frameworks. It includes the main App struct, AppDelegate, and related components such as menu bar integration, window management, update handling, and startup procedures. The file orchestrates app lifecycle events, UI setup, and external integrations.

classes.name: StatusItemMouseHandlerView
classes.description: A transparent NSView subclass that intercepts mouse events (clicks and hover) on the menu bar item, allowing custom behavior without affecting the menu bar item ownership.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: The application delegate handling startup, termination, URLs opening, and managing various startup tasks and lifecycle events.

methods.name: application(_:open:)
methods.description: Handles URLs opened with the app, possibly for deep linking.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching(_:)
methods.description: Performs initial setup after the app launches, including singleton checks, starting services, onboarding, and auto-opening chat if flagged.

methods.name: applicationWillTerminate(_:)
methods.description: Handles cleanup and shutdown tasks when the app terminates.

methods.name: scheduleFirstRunOnboardingIfNeeded
methods.description: Shows onboarding screens if the app is launched for the first time or after updates.

methods.name: isDuplicateInstance
methods.description: Checks whether another instance of the app is already running.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Method to trigger checking for app updates (through the Sparkle updater, if enabled).
